# Vendored C/C++ dependency manifest — audited by scripts/ci/cpp_dep_audit.sh
# (Phase-01.5 Task 1.5.3.4 supply-chain gate; spec §19.2).
#
# Every dependency vendored under core/third_party/ OR fetched by CMake
# FetchContent MUST be listed here. Columns are tab-separated:
#
#   name            — human label (also the OSV query name unless overridden)
#   version         — exact pinned version we ship/fetch
#   osv_name        — package name to query in the OSV feed ('-' to skip the
#                     feed check, e.g. for private forks — justify inline)
#   source          — upstream URL we vendored/fetched from
#
# After bumping any vendored dep, update its version here in the same commit —
# cpp_dep_audit.sh fails if a vendored directory or FetchContent_Declare block
# has no manifest entry.

googletest	1.14.0	googletest	https://github.com/google/googletest
